request.style: English, majestic orchestral, soaring male tenor with full choir, strings, French horns, trumpets, timpani, celesta, slow build to a radiant climax, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light
On those who lived in a land of deep shadow, light has dawned

[Verse]
The yoke upon their shoulders and the bar across their back
The rod of the oppressor lies shattered in its track
Every boot that tramped in tumult, every cloak rolled in blood
Is fuel now for the fire, and joy comes like a flood
They rejoice as at the harvest when the sheaves are carried in
The long night is ending and the morning will begin

[Chorus]
For to us a child is born, to us a son is given
And the government will rest on his shoulders
And his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor
Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

[Verse]
He will sit on David's throne and over all his land
With justice and with righteousness upheld by his hand
From now until forever his kingdom will not cease
The zeal of the LORD of hosts will accomplish this

[Chorus]
For to us a child is born, to us a son is given
And the government will rest on his shoulders
And his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor
Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

[Bridge]
Of the increase of his government and of peace there will be no end
The zeal of the LORD of hosts will accomplish this

[Outro]
Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God
Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace
